description: Monotonicity check (higher strike must not be priced above a lower strike) across a set of Polymarket markets that YOU have already confirmed share the same underlying asset and expiry/resolution date. Does NOT verify or infer that settlement-condition equivalence itself - Polymarket's API has no reliable field for it; passing unrelated markets produces a meaningless or false arbitrage signal. Accepts token_ids or market_slugs (+ optional outcomes, default all 'yes'), same length/order as strikes. Not investment advice. Paid in USDC on Base.

market_slugs.description: Polymarket market slug per rung, used to resolve token_ids automatically.

outcomes.description: "yes"/"no" per rung when using market_slugs (default: all "yes").

strikes.description: Strike for each rung, same order as token_ids/market_slugs. At least 2 required.

token_ids.description: CLOB token_id per rung, if already known. Mutually exclusive with market_slugs.

name: prediction.polymarket_mispricing
